clean_build_yaml: run build-cleaner.py on a build.yaml file to produce a cleaner sorted version
test_cleaned_yaml: set TEST=true and run build-cleaner.py to verify a build.yaml is already clean
rebuild_as_ordered_dict: rebuild a dictionary as an OrderedDict with special keys prioritized before others
clean_elem: clean a build element dict by sorting proto files before others and reordering keys
repr_ordered_dict: register a YAML representer that preserves OrderedDict key ordering during dump
